title: Playboy April 2005 Christy Hemme WWE Diva Mena Suvari Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, April 2005. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: WWE champion Diva Christy Hemme - from Raw to ravishing.

Cover features: Uday Hussein's plot against Saddam (exclusive); Brazilian beauties; CBS's Les Moonves interview; Mena Suvari 20Q; best spring suits; Phil Gordon's poker night; T.C. Boyle fiction; the ad world of Donny Deutsch.

Back cover: HBO Deadwood ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
